claim.why_it_matters: The section heading appears twice and the first copy sits on the Debug page XV-10, so a tool locating Section XVI by heading finds it on the wrong page.
claim.detail: Page 698 (XV-10) prints no Section XVI heading; the heading is printed on page 699, where the markdown also carries it as `# <u>SECTION XVI: SEGMENTATION MODULE</u>`. The copy at the end of page 698 is a stray duplicate.

verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of page 698 shows the boxed Debug rules (23)-(24) ending with 'general rules 5 and 6).', then blank space, the folio XV-10 and the copyright line; no Section XVI heading is printed. specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 26081 carries '# SECTION XVI: SEGMENTATION MODULE' after 'XV-10' and before '## Page 699', and line 26087 carries the genuine heading '# <u>SECTION XVI: SEGMENTATION MODULE</u>' on page 699. The page-698 copy is a stray duplicate H1 heading on the wrong page. No normative text changes, so the structural severity is right.
